notes:
Russian-occupied territories, written by eu-22-g on 2026-11-01 from one page of its own (Russian-occupied territories) plus two pages read for the russian-federation dossier.

This Cliopatria row is an aggregate carried as a leaf polity, a member of the (Russian Federation) umbrella, not a state. Its 6,999.6 km2 shape is Transnistria (19 Moldovan cells) plus six cells of South Ossetia, the same for 1992-2023 and 2024. It is typed umbrella here so that it is not coloured as territory; the lands themselves are drawn by the transnistria, republic-of-abkhazia, republic-of-south-ossetia, donetsk-people-s-republic and luhansk-people-s-republic dossiers, and the hatching of occupied land comes from the occupation_start events in russian-federation (Transnistria 1992, Abkhazia and South Ossetia 2008, Crimea 2014, Kherson and Zaporizhzhia 2022) and the owners' mirror events. The keyframes here list the occupied lands per era for the state page.

Not on the page: areas of any territory, the Donbas extent, the front lines after 2022, Russian garrisons in Transnistria, South Ossetia and Abkhazia before 2008. The page's '7% of Ukraine's territory' carries no year and is not used. Cliopatria's South Ossetia cells before 2008 are dropped because the page dates the occupation to 2008. The Georgian region is written as an intersection with Cliopatria's own shape because Natural Earth has no South Ossetia admin-1.


Revision of 2026-11-01 (after the adversarial review). (1) Added the 2022 Donbas gain (about 60% of Donetsk Oblast and Luhansk Oblast beyond the 2014 lines) that the 2022 keyframe already carried, and the November 2022 loss of the right bank of Kherson Oblast (2022 Kherson counteroffensive page); the 2022 keyframe now holds for 2022 only, a new 2023 keyframe and the 2024 keyframe leave the right bank out. (2) Type: kept as umbrella. The reviewer asks the orchestrator to choose between an umbrella with documented exceptions and folding the dossier into russian-federation. The author keeps it: the Cliopatria row 'Russian-occupied territories' has its own two shapes, which the validator requires some dossier to review, and the schema's umbrella ('never coloured as territory') is what the page's list of occupied lands is; folding it would put two Cliopatria Names into russian-federation, whose own Cliopatria shape is a state. Its gain and loss events therefore have no mirrors, because the owners record the same lands as russian-federation occupation_start events (Transnistria, Abkhazia and South Ossetia, Crimea, the south) and, for the Donbas, as the DPR and LPR dossiers' own territory; a renderer should not colour this dossier. (3) Not changed: the 2008 war zones (W1 stays empty; russian-federation now carries the Russo-Georgian War zones).
